function.name: web_search
function.description:
Search the web for information about a topic.

``q`` accepts a single string or a list of strings. List queries
dispatch in parallel and merge into one result, deduplicated by URL —
one turn can cover multiple angles without burning extra steps.

Args:
    q: A query string, or a list of strings for parallel dispatch.
    num_results: Organic results per query (default 10, max 100).
    gl: Country/region code (default "us"). Examples: "cn", "uk", "de".
    hl: Language code (default "en"). Examples: "zh", "es", "fr".
    tbs: Time filter. Examples: "qdr:h" / "qdr:d" / "qdr:w" / "qdr:m" / "qdr:y".

Returns:
    Formatted results with answers, knowledge graph, and organic links.
    Multi-query calls return one block per query separated by ``---``.

function.name: web_fetch
function.description:
Scrape and extract content from one or more web pages.

Automatic backend selection based on URL domain: PMC / PubMed / bioRxiv /
medRxiv URLs go to the corresponding OA API; known paywall domains are
routed via Unpaywall; everything else goes through Jina Reader. Retry,
negative cache, and arXiv PDF→HTML redirect are applied automatically.

A non-empty ``info_to_extract`` routes the raw content through a cheap
summary LLM that extracts only the information requested. With it
omitted the raw extracted text is returned (subject to overflow trim).

Args:
    url: A URL string, or a list of URLs for parallel fetch.
    info_to_extract: Optional focus for the summary LLM. A single
        string applies to every URL; a list pairs with ``url`` 1:1.

Returns:
    For a single URL, the extracted content directly. For a list, a
    numbered block per URL: ``[i] URL: …\n    Info: …``.

function.name: scholar_search
function.description:
Search Google Scholar for academic papers, preprints, and citations.

Use this for scientific/technical claims, benchmark papers, method
lookups, or when citation counts matter for credibility. Results
are sorted by citation count (most-cited first).

Args:
    query: The search query string.
    num_results: Number of results to return (default 10, max 20).
    gl: Country/region code (default "us").
    hl: Language code (default "en").

Returns:
    Markdown-formatted list of papers with title, authors/year,
    citation count, snippet, landing-page URL, and PDF URL where
    available.

function.name: run_python_code
function.description:
Execute Python code in an isolated sandbox environment.

Pre-installed packages: numpy, pandas, scipy, sympy, matplotlib,
networkx, requests, beautifulsoup4.

Args:
    code: Python source code to execute.
    timeout: Maximum execution time in seconds (default 60).

Returns:
    stdout + stderr from the execution, or an error message.

function.name: read_file
function.description:
Read complete archived research output or a file from configured allowed local directories or the E2B sandbox. Archived tool-result JSON files in the worker artifact directory expose their original content.

For short files, returns the text unchanged. Long files return a page with total, start, end and next_start_char metadata. Character positions count decoded Unicode characters, not bytes; start is zero-based and end is exclusive. Continue with start_char=next_start_char until it is null. max_chars limits the text payload to at most 15000 characters, excluding the small metadata header.

Line mode: start_line/end_line are optional one-based inclusive line bounds (0 means beginning/end). If a line range exceeds max_chars, the page also gives line_range_end_char, the exclusive absolute character position at which the requested line range ends. To continue, omit line bounds, use start_char, and limit max_chars to min(15000, line_range_end_char-start_char) when staying within that range.

Character mode: start_char cannot be combined with nonzero start_line or end_line. An offset equal to total returns an empty final page; offsets greater than total are invalid. Explicit character reads always include pagination metadata.

Use only paths within configured local read roots or worker artifacts; absolute sandbox paths are also supported. Returns text, or a tool error for invalid arguments or inaccessible files.

start_line.description: Optional one-based inclusive first line; 0 starts at the beginning. Do not combine nonzero line bounds with start_char.

end_line.description: Optional one-based inclusive last line; 0 reads to the end. Must not precede start_line when both are nonzero.

start_char.description: Optional zero-based offset into the complete decoded content, in Unicode characters. Resume from next_start_char without nonzero line bounds.

max_chars.description: Maximum content characters per page (metadata is additional). For continuation within a prior line range, do not exceed line_range_end_char-start_char.

function.name: submit_report
function.description:
Submit your final research report and end this task.

Call this **once** when you have gathered enough evidence and are ready
to return to the main agent. The solver loop terminates after this turn.

Args:
    content: The complete report in the mandatory format:
        ``Scope: ...\nFinding: ...\nEvidence:\n  - ...\nConfidence: ...``.
        Include exact values, source URLs, and code results — not just
        conclusions.
    confidence: Self-assessed confidence in [0, 1] that your findings
        are correct and well-sourced. Default 0.7.

Returns:
    Short acknowledgement. The report body is surfaced to the main
    agent via ``<report agent="NAME">...</report>``.
